text-area.name: Text Area
text-area.purpose: Use Text Area for longer free-form operational text that needs a visible label, helper or recovery copy, optional character count, and multiline editing.
text-area.referenceRationale: The ZIP reference gives the visual benchmark: full-width multiline surface, 12 by 16 padding, vertical resize, optional bottom-right counter, and fast focus/error transitions. Design System owns tokens, density, state, and accessibility semantics.

anatomy.rule: Names the long-form value and remains visible.
Owns rows, resize, value, placeholder, focus, disabled, and error styles.
Explains purpose, format, privacy, or recovery.
Shows progress toward maxLength without replacing validation.

text-area.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > focus > filled > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for surface, border, counter, error, and disabled color.
Energy.behavior: Energy keeps long text readable while state remains visible.
Energy.example: Driver notes preserve neutral surface and clear error identity.
Energy.test: Verify contrast for value, helper, counter, error, and disabled.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for label, placeholder, value, helper, counter, and recovery.
Voice.example: Notes explain visibility to the driver.
Voice.test: Verify label, helper, counter, and error text render.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for full width, rows, padding, resize, and container fit.
Frame.behavior: Frame prevents clipping in narrow containers.
Frame.example: Support notes stack on mobile and fit desktop forms.
Frame.rejectIf: Width or height is fixed outside density rules.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only on surrounding surfaces.
Depth.behavior: Depth does not replace text area state.
Depth.example: A form panel may have depth while the field stays flat.
Depth.test: Verify focus and error do not rely on shadow.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum touch/enter for focus, error, loading, and counter feedback.
Momentum.behavior: Motion confirms state without delaying typing.
Momentum.rejectIf: Motion blocks input or uses raw curves.

State.decision: Use State to resolve disabled, loading, error, focus, filled, and default.
State.behavior: State controls visual precedence and interaction.
State.example: Disabled blocks editing; error beats focus.
State.rejectIf: State is visual only or contradictory.

Tone.decision: Use Tone for clear guidance and recovery copy.
Tone.behavior: Tone explains what the long text is for.
Tone.example: Use 'Visible to the driver' instead of vague notes.
Tone.test: Verify recovery copy tells what to fix.
Tone.rejectIf: Copy hides privacy, risk, or audience.

Growth.decision: Use Growth for reusable multiline input across notes, comments, and explanations.
Growth.behavior: Growth keeps API stable as rich text patterns appear later.
Growth.example: Driver notes and dispute comments share one contract.
Growth.rejectIf: A product forks one-off multiline behavior.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol only for optional adjacent affordances outside the text surface.
Symbol.behavior: Symbol never replaces label, helper, or counter.
Symbol.example: An error icon can support recovery copy.
Symbol.test: Verify icons do not hide text.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography for status affordances outside the typed value.
Iconography.behavior: Icons inherit state and stay secondary.
Iconography.example: Error icon appears near helper text.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for visible label, multiline semantics, describedby, maxLength, error, disabled, and focus.
Accessibility.example: Counter and error are associated with the textarea.
Accessibility.test: Verify label, describedby, aria-invalid, maxLength, disabled, and focus.
Accessibility.rejectIf: The field cannot be understood without sight.

productExamples.example: Add delivery notes visible to the driver.

do: Use maxLength when length affects downstream work.
dont: Do not use for short identifiers.
Do not replace validation with counter only.
Do not introduce rich text behavior in the base component.
info: Rich text, mentions, templates, and comment threads become patterns later.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: large inspector fields and remote-entry surfaces

tests: Renders visible label, value, helper, placeholder, rows, maxLength, and counter.
Supports focus, typing, resize, disabled, loading, and validation.
Associates helper, counter, and error text through describedby.
Preserves value across loading and error.
Adapts full-width and responsive layouts without overflow.
agentInstructions: Use Text Area for longer free-form text.
Ask before adding rich text, mentions, templates, or comment-thread behavior.
rejectIf: Label is missing or only placeholder exists.
Rich text behavior is added to the base component.
Raw color, spacing, radius, or motion bypasses tokens.
